entities.name: Francisco de Paula Ceballos y Vargas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco de Paula de Ceballos and Vargas was a Spanish Lieutenant General who acted as captain general in Catalonia and Cuba. He was also Senator for life as Senator, representing Santander Province.
